results.title: Khan Academy Kids Pricing: Free for Families and Teachers
results.snippet: In support of our ongoing mission to provide a free, world-class education to all children, everywhere, the Khan Academy Kids app, and all 4,000+ activities, are 100% free for individual teachers and families to use.

results.title: Free Learning App for Kids Ages 2-8 | Khan Academy Kids
results.snippet: ... Yes — the mobile app is 100% free, with no ads or subscriptions. For schools and districts using Khan Academy Kids across multiple classrooms, we recommend Khan Academy Kids for Schools.

results.title: NEW: Khan Kids for Schools - Khan Academy - Zendesk
results.snippet: Available at $5 per student, the Khan Kids for Schools is a worthwhile investment in a tool that will build foundational academic skills and make it easy for teachers to make data-informed instructional decisions.

results.title: Khan Academy Pricing: What's Free and What Costs Money - Nibble Blog
results.snippet: Yes. Khan Academy Kids is a separate app built specifically for early learners, and it's completely free to download and use, with no hidden charges.
